## Description
Brief summary of changes introduced in this pull request.

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: A new feature
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without changing behavior
- [ ] `test`: Adding or updating tests
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, configuration, or dependency updates

## Pull Request Checklist
- [ ] Commit messages strictly follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] Unit tests pass locally (`npm run test`)
- [ ] Linter checks pass (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Application builds without errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Relevant documentation in `/docs` and `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] Verified preview deployment (if on staging/PR)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, API keys, or personal tokens committed
